attempts.summary: Created a local root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RHEL 9) using openssl, installed its certificate into the system trust store via /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors plus update-ca-trust extract, verified trust with `trust list` and an openssl verify against the system bundle, and confirmed end-to-end trust by signing and verifying a test leaf certificate. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and CA state, restarted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reconnection, confirmed a changed boot_id proving an actual reboot, and re-verified the CA anchor/key/trust status persisted after restart.
